puzzle.mini_ru.name: Mini
puzzle.mini_ru.rule.words: Fill the grid with Russian words using Russian clues. This is a separate puzzle from the English Mini.
puzzle.mini_ru.keyboard: Type Russian letters; Backspace clears. Arrows move; Space changes between Across and Down.
puzzle.codeword_ru.name: Codeword
puzzle.codeword_ru.tagline: Give every number its Russian letter.
puzzle.codeword_ru.rule.words: Every word across and down is Russian. The numbered letters use the Russian alphabet.
puzzle.codeword_ru.keyboard: With a number selected, type its Russian letter; type it again to clear. Backspace clears; arrows move between numbers.
puzzle.cipher_ru.name: Cipher
puzzle.cipher_ru.tagline: A sum of Russian words, with digits hidden.
puzzle.cipher_ru.rule.words: The sum uses Russian words and Cyrillic letters. Each letter still stands for an ordinary decimal digit.
puzzle.cipher_ru.keyboard: Type a Russian letter to select it, then a digit. Backspace clears; arrows move between letters.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.intro: A small Russian crossword. Each numbered word has a Russian clue. Letters belong to both the word across and the word down.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.first: Try 1 Across: «{clue}». Select its first square and type НОС. Each letter moves the cursor on.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.first_retry: Fill only the top row with НОС. You can use the Russian letter keys below the grid.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.first_done: НОС is in. Its letters also begin the words down.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.turn: Tap the top-left square, then tap it again. The selection turns from Across to Down, and the clue changes with it.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.turn_retry: Tap the first square twice to select 1 Down. Keep the letters already entered.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.turn_done: Now the same square reads down.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.second: Now choose 4 Across in the middle row: «{clue}». Turn the direction if needed, then type ОСА.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.second_retry: Keep НОС in the top row and type ОСА across the middle row.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.second_done: ОСА is in. Read the crossings to finish the last row.
puzzle.mini_ru.tutorial.play: Your turn: finish the last row using its clue and the crossing words. Hints work here too.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.intro: Every number is one Russian letter, the same everywhere. This example makes НОС, ОСА and САД across and down. Numbers 2 and 3 are already Д and Н.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.first: Practise entering the top word, НОС. Select number 4, then tap О. Both squares numbered 4 fill together.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.first_retry: Select a square numbered 4, or number 4 on the pad, then tap the Russian О.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.second: Complete НОС by giving number 5 the letter С. One choice fills every 5, including the crossings.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.second_retry: Select number 5 and tap С. Keep number 4 as О.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.second_done: The same С now links three words.
puzzle.codeword_ru.tutorial.play: Finish the remaining numbers. Every row and column must spell a Russian word, and different numbers must use different letters. Hints explain a step.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.intro: НОС + СОН = СЕНО. Every letter stands for one digit, the same everywhere, and different letters have different digits. Find the digits that make the sum true.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.first: Two three-digit numbers make a four-digit total. The extra first С is the carry, so С = 1. Select С, then tap 1.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.first_retry: Select a С tile or its letter key, then tap digit 1.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.second: The hundreds make 10 or 11, so Е is 0 or 1. С already has 1, so Е = 0. Select Е and tap 0. A 0 is allowed inside a word.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.second_retry: Keep С = 1. Select Е, then give it digit 0.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.second_done: Е is 0, and no word starts with it.
puzzle.cipher_ru.tutorial.play: Finish the sum by working through the columns and their carries. Different letters still need different digits. Hints can explain a step.
